about_the_game:
A Modern Dating 



Experience modern dating like never before in Date Banger! Swipe through videos just like a regular dating app, and connect with the girls you like. Invite those who respond to your messages to your home for an exciting date party, where you get to know each other better.

As your relationship progresses, your chances of a deeper connection increase. Don't like a girl? Move on to the next one—each girl has its own unique experince. Find the one that fits your style perfectly.




Use your fully interactive phone to call the girls, tell them what you want to do, and invite them over. Strengthen your relationships by sending gifts, but remember, each girl has different preferences. Some love jewelry, while others wouldn't trade a long stick for anything else.



Take risks to earn money; if passive income isn't enough, use your phone for opportunities to get rich. Upgrade your home and enjoy different spots like the bathtub, swing, and kitchen counter. Buy new music to keep the vibe fresh and fun.

There's no reason why the girls won't fall in love with you in Date Banger!

content_descriptors.notes:
“Date Banger” is a game where adults go out on a date, have a good time and then have sexual intercourse. All the people in the game is 18+ adults. Every sex act happens with consent.

Tobacco and alcohol use do not play a role in the game.
